newsitem.title: UK: Sugar mixed, May, August dominate light trade.
newsitem.headline: Sugar mixed, May, August dominate light trade.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was mixed by 1601 GMT, with May and August dominating business.
Active May was 80 cents up at $310.80, off a high of $311.20 but August was down 40 cents at $307.30, off a high of $308.40.
Total volume of 1,985 lots was dominated by May with 1,079 lots and August with 791, as switches between the two inflated a quiet day's trade, traders said.
The market remained directionless, in the absence of fundamental news or a strong signal from New York.
Although some reckon today's move showed that LIFFE sugar had broken out of its tight range, others were sceptical. "They're just grasping at straws," one said.

He felt that New York was not in a position to provide the lead London needed. Another trader expressed disappointment with the influence of New York on Friday. "It's just trading in the same range as yesterday," he said. New York sugar was flat to a touch higher in early going.
